post: Week 1 · Sat · Meet your Council Leaders
caption:
Meet the people who'll guide you inside AI Builder's Camp 👋

Every ABC builder joins a small AI Council led by a Council Leader. You meet every week to share progress, get unstuck and keep each other moving forward.

Say hi to Coach Ann, Coach David, Coach Renz, Coach Maron, Coach Arv, Coach Joshua, Coach Gab and Coach Clark. 💜

Questions about the support you'll get in ABC? Ask us in the comments or send us a message.

#AIBuildersCamp #AIEmpoweredClub #YourAIBestie
